source_correspondence: T0 fixes the complete smooth single-face weak wave class, including time dependence, an interior spatial cross block, scalar principal matrix, arbitrary complex matrix lower terms, both actual form domains and the natural-dual source on one open source-free region.

T1 uses the actual SG characteristic-containment theorem. Positive spatial energy bounds every characteristic lift after normalizing absolute time momentum to one. The singular front and its full lift are relatively closed, including both hyperbolic roots.

T2 retains the actual NW cotangent map, time-momentum shift, density and weak-form covariance. Direct differentiation proves nonconstant symbol scaling of the gliding field. Its correct formula has a plus sign because H_x H_p x equals minus H_x squared p. The physical clock is nonvanishing and all changes of speed retain the proved quadratic center estimates.

T3 verifies the entire non-glancing hypothesis of the closed-set theorem using the exact interior, transverse reflection and two-domain strict diffraction results for the same source, solution and wave-front convention.

T4 verifies the compact-uniform directional hypothesis from the actual NW parabolic-window theorem and PW witness construction. Both time directions, one compact-anchor constant, normal-root control and the Taylor error of the correctly normalized center are retained. No continuous choice of witnesses is assumed.

T5 invokes the complete earlier closed-set construction only after discharging all its analytic hypotheses. The signed-root compactness proof and higher-contact integral equation give an actual local singular generalized ray, including the required glancing derivative.

T6 checks joining at every geometric type. An explicit successive extension chosen close to its remaining endpoint capacity gives a two-sided maximal arc without requiring uniqueness. A finite compact cover supplies a uniform speed bound and exit buffer; a finite accumulating endpoint would have a unique singular limit and extend, a contradiction. The physical clock handles infinite endpoints.

T7 proves that the actual front is a union of maximal rays. Finite-contact uniqueness implies the entire unique ray is singular. At infinite contact the claim is existence of a singular continuation; the regular-region corollary correctly requires every possible maximal ray to meet the regular region.

Three full solutions verify all coordinates and momenta of reflected, strict tangent and gliding examples, the exact exponential change of gliding speed and its quadratic constant, and compact endpoint continuation. Thirty-six exact symbolic checks verify Hamilton equations, the characteristic constraint, compressed continuity, the gliding-field scaling and figure constants.

The 186 formulas and 23 displays parse; document widths and all mobile display and figure extents pass. The illustration shows exact physical-time normal-position projections for three different operators, with omitted coordinates explicitly labelled.
